votes.motion: Grant the Chapter 100 Auctioneer License to Petrowsky Auctioneers Inc.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt motioned to grant the chapter 100 auctioneer license to petrowsky auctioneers inc. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Authorize Chair David Matthews to sign the MSBA contract for the BOS (feasibility study).
votes.quote: mr. matthews asked for a vote from the board to authorize his signing of the contract for the bos. ms. bertram motioned to approve the vote. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Approve the Earth Removal Permit renewals, with the caveat that all requirements detailed by the Town Manager are met.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the barth removal permits with the caveat that all of the requirements for the permits, as detailed by the town manager, are met.

votes.motion: Continue the appointment of Myleen Mallari as acting Treasurer/Collector through September 4, 2012.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to continue the appointment of myleen mallari as acting treasurer/collector through september 4, 2012. ms. bertram seconded. on vote, motion carried, 4 in favor, 0 opposed.
mr. debettencourt motioned to adjourn the meeting. ms. bertram seconded. the board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 8:15pm.

budget_items.topic: Average property tax bill comparison (public comment)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Matthews read FY11 and FY12 average property tax bills for Lunenburg and the State, with the resulting percentage gap and town rank.
budget_items.quote: fy11 the average property tax bill in lunenburg was $4,064. average property tax bill for the state was $4,537.

budget_items.topic: EPG Solar net metering credits: rate and savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Londa explained the supply and distribution components of the credit value; the first-year savings from EPG's proposal were estimated at about $78K, and EPG later revised its rate to produce $84K annually.
budget_items.quote: based upon what epg solar had proposed, the savings for the first year look to be about $78k.

budget_items.topic: EPG Solar net metering credits: current rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Londa said the rate EPG had submitted, 7 cents per KWH, was a little high against the current supply rate.
budget_items.quote: the current rate is .062 cents per kwh and epg was using 7 cents per kwh.

budget_items.topic: EPG Solar revised rate and savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Speidel told Londa that EPG had revised the cost of the KWH to 6.6 cents, a savings of $84K annually.
budget_items.quote: epg had revised the cost of the kwh to 6.6 cents which will be a savings of $84k annually.

budget_items.topic: PILOT value and tax estimate for solar project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Speidel reported the Regional Assessor's view that the $14,207 in taxes is good, against a stated $45K-$55K per MW value range and a highest-seen PILOT of $12K; Ms. Bertram said the gap between $45K-$55K and $14K concerned her.
budget_items.quote: the assessor thinks that the $14,207 in taxes is good because the highest he has seen moving forward is $12k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Speidel reported 100 donations totaling $27,328 from the July 14, 2012 relief project, broken out by department in a table.
Warrant totals were listed for the 8/13/12, 8/14/12 and 8/15/12 warrants; no vote is recorded on them.
Speidel reported a volunteer's review of town and school phone services; the per-line rate dropped from $33 to $13 under the 2010 consultant work, a significant savings.
budget_items.quote: the rate per line dropped from $33 - $13 per line which is a significant savings.
